landing.heroDescription: LEGASH connects donors and hospitals directly. When a hospital posts an urgent request, every nearby donor with a matching blood type hears about it.
landing.factVerifyEmail: Every donor account starts with email verification.
landing.factAdminReview: Hospitals are reviewed by an admin before they go live.

how.title: Three steps to save a life.
how.description: Donors and hospitals use LEGASH differently — but every path leads to the same handoff: a request, a match, a call.
how.donorStep1Desc: Name, blood type, location, and a password. Confirm your email and you're in — no waiting on anyone.
how.donorStep2Desc: When a hospital within your radius needs your blood type, you get notified. Nothing reaches you otherwise.
how.donorStep3Desc: Accept, and that hospital gets your phone and email so they can reach you. Decline, and they learn nothing.
how.hospitalStep1Desc: Hospital name, license number, location, and current stock. An admin reviews your account before it goes live.
how.hospitalStep2Desc: Matching donors in your configured radius are notified immediately — no manual outreach needed.
how.hospitalStep3Desc: Only accepted donors' contact info appears. Everything else is worked out in person, when they arrive.

landing.impactDescription: Every day, the gap between need and supply costs lives. Here's what the numbers tell us.
landing.stat1Description: This is the national demand for blood across hospitals and healthcare facilities every single day.
landing.stat2Description: Despite the need, only a fraction of what's required is actually collected each day.
landing.aboutParagraph1: LEGASH is a dedicated team of developers and health advocates building the connection Ethiopia desperately needs. We've created a system that instantly matches hospitals with nearby donors who have the right blood type — eliminating the chaos of manual outreach and social media pleas.
landing.aboutParagraph2: Our platform is simple: hospitals post urgent requests, matching donors receive immediate alerts, and connections happen in seconds. No more families scrambling to find donors. No more preventable delays. Just a direct, secure link between those who can give and those who need it most.
landing.aboutParagraph3: We're not just building software — we're building a lifeline for Ethiopia's healthcare system, one match at a time.
landing.privacyDescription: Hospitals can see you're nearby with the right blood type — but they can't see who you are until you choose to reveal yourself. Click below to see how it works.
landing.mobileTitle: LEGASH is also available as a mobile app for donors.
landing.mobileDescription: Sign up with just your phone number and PIN, receive instant alerts for compatible blood requests, and accept or decline with one tap — all from your phone.
landing.securityDescription: We vet every facility manually to ensure a 100% legitimate hospital-to-donor connection.
landing.featureRadiusDesc: Targeted alerts to nearby matching donors.
landing.footerDescription: The link between Ethiopia's health care and a verified network of donors. Built to help the health care system and donors connect and work together to save lives.

terms.title: Terms & Privacy Policy
terms.intro: Last updated: October 24, 2023. Please review these terms carefully as they govern your use of the LEGASH platform.
terms.dataP1: We are committed to protecting your privacy. This section explains how we collect, use, and safeguard your personal information when you use our services. We only collect data necessary to provide and improve the LEGASH experience.
terms.dataP2: Your health information, including blood type and donation history, is encrypted and stored securely. We adhere strictly to national health data regulations to ensure your sensitive information remains confidential.
terms.usageP1: LEGASH does not sell your personal data to third parties. Your information is only shared when necessary to facilitate a blood donation request or to comply with legal obligations.
terms.usageP2: When you respond to a donation request, your contact details may be shared with the requesting party or the partner hospital, only with your explicit consent for that specific transaction.
terms.verificationP1: To ensure the safety and integrity of the LEGASH community, all accounts must undergo a verification process. This may involve confirming your phone number, email address, or identity via government-issued ID.
terms.verificationP2: Unverified accounts may face restrictions in interacting with active requests or making direct contact with other users.
terms.responsibilitiesP1: By using this app, you agree to provide accurate and up-to-date health information. You acknowledge that providing false information regarding your donation eligibility can have serious medical consequences.
terms.responsibilityB1: Maintain the confidentiality of your account credentials.
terms.responsibilityB2: Respect the privacy and circumstances of other users.
terms.responsibilityB3: Report any suspicious activity or violations of these terms immediately.
